{{Color|Uncommon}} |music-1 = [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Main Skincrate Opening|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Who knew cheap plastic and toy blasters could be so deadly?|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|Opens up toy themed skins that shoot special darts!|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Toy Crate '''is a crate purchasable for {{Coins|850}}. It gives unique skins that cannot be unlocked by any other crate. Each skin that can be gotten from the '''Toy Crate''' has a rarity which affects how likely you are to unlock the skin. {{Color|Common}} skins cost {{Coins|850}} and {{Color|Uncommon}} skins cost {{Coins|1,000}}. The higher rarities also have costs, but they remain unused. If such skins were to be added in the future, {{Color|Rare}} skins would cost {{Coins|99,999}} while {{Color|Legendary}} skins would cost {{Coins|99,999}}. It is similar to [[Basic Crate]], as it is a cardboard box, but it has a red color and a picture of a [[w:c:roblox:Catalog:Bloxxer|Bloxxer]] explosion can be seen on the side of it. ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:Toyminigunnerrework.png|175px]] |[[File:ToyRocketeerIcon2025.png|175px]] |[[File:KRToySoldier0.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Toy|Toy}} |{{Color|Toy|Toy}} |{{Color|Toy|Toy}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Uncommon}} |{{Color|Common}} |{{Color|Common}} |- !Cost |{{Coins|1,000}} |{{Coins|850}} |{{Coins|850}} |- !Tower |[[Minigunner]] |[[Rocketeer]] |[[Soldier]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Crate Icons}} Toy Crate.png|First version (18 March 2020 – 22 April 2026) }} ==Trivia== *When {{Color|Toy|Toy}} skins from this crate were added to the daily skin store, there was a bug where {{Color|Common}} skins were sold for {{Robux|10}} instead of {{Coins|4,000}}. Additionally, you were not purchasing the skin but instead a t-shirt. **Because of this, it was impossible to get the skins. **The t-shirt was called "''I love builderman!!!''". It had "''I❤️BM''" written on it, alongside random green scribbles. ==Update History== {{scroll|text= *'''18 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.1]] **'''Toy Crate''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Toy Crate''' can now give duplicate skins when all skins are unlocked. **Crate opening music added. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]]f **Skin rarity added. **Skins can now appear in the daily skin store. **'''Toy Crate''' can no longer give duplicate skins. **{{Bug}} Crate opening music no longer plays. **{{Bug}} When a {{Color|Common}} skin is on sale, you purchase a "''I love builderman!!!''" t-shirt for {{Robux|10}} instead of the skin for {{Coins|4,000}}. *'''13 January 2023''' - [[v1.6.0]]h **{{Bugfix}} {{Color|Common}} skin are now properly purchasable in the daily skin store. "''I love builderman!!!''" t-shirt is no longer sold by them. *'''5 August 2023''' - [[v1.8.4]] **Cost decreased from {{Coins|3,500}} to {{Coins|850}}. **{{Color|Common}} skin cost decreased from {{Coins|4,000}} to {{Coins|850}}. **{{Color|Uncommon}} skin cost decreased from {{Coins|4,250}} to {{Coins|1,000}}. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Icon changed. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **{{Color|Uncommon}} rarity added. **{{Color|Rare}} skin cost increased from {{Coins|1,500}} to {{Coins|99,999}}. **{{Color|Legendary}} skin cost increased from {{Coins|2,000}} to {{Coins|99,999}}. }} {{CrateNavBox}}
